_about: Hims UK hair-loss quiz definition, rebuilt from what the site serves to an anonymous browser. Part 1 is the complete anonymous flow (exact wording, every option, the one-path branch table). Part 2 lists what public code and documents show about the steps behind the account wall. Checked 2026-11-23.

anonymousFlow.source: GraphQL query "Flow" (flowVersion) that app.forhims.co.uk itself sends to https://api.external.eu.eucalyptus.vc/graphql when the quiz opens. Raw copy: raw/flow-anon-hair.a9a88e4a.graphql.json (also runs/baseline-men/net/04-*.json).
anonymousFlow.branchModel: The served definition has 21 steps and 20 branches. Every step has exactly one outgoing branch and the branch objects carry no condition (the client only asks for id, sourceStepId, targetStepId). So the anonymous quiz is one straight path: no answer can skip, add or stop a step. After each answer the browser posts it (mutation SubmitStepResponseAnonymously, under a guest token, kept 7 days) and the server replies with nextStep; in the baseline run the reply always matched this table.

eligibilityEngine_code.query: HimsUkHairPurchaseOptions(consultationId) -> consultation.purchasePrompt.options { recommendedPreset, defaultPreset, entries[ PurchasePreset { contentKey, eligible, denials, paymentPlan, offeringSelection.sequenceSelections.sequence { deliveryIntervalCode, tags } } ] }
eligibilityEngine_code.meaning: The server returns every product/plan combination ("preset") with eligible true/false and a list of denials (types seen in code: PurchasePresetRuleMatchedDenial, PurchasePresetMissingDenial). The hero product is the one holding recommendedPreset, else defaultPreset, else the first. A product whose default preset has eligible === false is listed as unavailable and greyed out. Strength comes from sequence tags that look like "1.1mg"; plan length from the delivery interval code.

oldPlatform_code.tagEngine: Server returns "assessment.contraindications" (a list of tags). Every active product whose Contentful tags include one of them is removed; the tag "all" removes everything. Each answer option in the Contentful intake could carry "excludesTags"; questions could be shown only for certain products ("includedBy") or only after a trigger answer ("trigger").
